explorer.examples.bounded-channel.descri: channel pacing for send and receive
queueBatches sends draft into the buffer, and writeBatches receives it without waiting.
queueBatches creates a capacity-one channel shared with writeBatches.
writeBatches later reaches an empty channel and waits for archive.
The review and publish sends reach a full channel and wait for writeBatches.
explorer.examples.bounded-channel.title: Bounded Channel
explorer.examples.failure-driven-cancell: launchCampaign enters branch to run sendCampaign.
After sendEmailBatch throws, branch cancels the still-sleeping refreshAudience and sendCampaign processes.
sendEmailBatch and refreshAudience both belong to the sendCampaign scope.
The branch call then throws the scope failure, interrupting launchCampaign.

explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.fork: loadPage spawns loadHeader and loadSidebar as parallel processes.
explorer.examples.fork-join.guide.join: loadPage waits for each spawned process, then returns the combined page data.
explorer.examples.fork-join.title: Fork Join
explorer.examples.future-settlement.guid: receiveSmsCode settles smsCode with the received code.
verifyPhoneNumber waits on smsCode until another process settles it.
explorer.examples.recovery-boundary.desc: resumable recovery inside a guard boundary
explorer.examples.recovery-boundary.guid: publishListing enters guard to run reviewListing.
reviewListing starts scanPhotos through resumable and waits for the value from resumable.
After scanPhotos fails inside its child scope, guard lets approveManually handle the failure in the same boundary.
approveManually returns approval, and resumable gives that value back to reviewListing's wait point.
scope-managed future and channel life cycles
openSession creates ticket and updates inside its child scope.
When the openSession child scope converges, it cancels the unfinished future and revokes the open channel.
resumeCheckout can still use ticket and updates, but the runtime objects stay owned by the scope that created them.
Later wait and tryReceive only observe those terminal states.
explorer.examples.scope-owned-work.guide: publishArticle enters branch to run commitArticle, then returns its result.
commitArticle produces published before updateSearchIndex finishes.
branch creates a child scope that owns work spawned inside the boundary.
branch waits for scope-owned work before returning.
explorer.examples.scope-owned-work.title: Scope-Owned Work
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.cal: submitOrder returns order accepted without waiting for sendReceiptEmail.
explorer.examples.single-spawn.guide.spa: submitOrder starts sendReceiptEmail as a spawned process.
